core_obligations: Choose the Tate resolution; let xi and theta be the element and derivation from the two named lemmas.

Verify the pivotal identity theta^n(gamma_n(xi)) = g^n in S/IS: it follows by induction from the displayed DP-compatibility of theta (d(gamma_n(x)) = d(x) gamma_{n-1}(x)), theta(xi) = g, and multiplicativity of theta on degree-0 classes.
Conclude: g not nilpotent forces xi^n nonzero in H_{2n}(A/IA) for all n > 0.
Identify H_{2n}(A/IA) = Tor^R_{2n}(S, R/I) and conclude infinitely many nonzero Tor groups, so S is not perfect over R.
proof_roadmap: Chain the two named constructions, prove the theta-gamma identity by induction, and read off the infinitude of Tor.
difficulty_reason: The proof is short but its pivotal identity and the DP bookkeeping are the mathematical heart of the Vasconcelos-adjacent obstruction argument.
